purpose: Automatically extract observable global ORDER BY obligations from Spark's analyzed LogicalPlan without manual SQL key specifications; report only in-scope witnesses and UNKNOWN otherwise
coverage_rules: Only analyze root-level global Sort under WithCTE and GlobalLimit/LocalLimit/Offset wrappers
Only SortOrder whose direct child is an AttributeReference with exprId matching an exposed output attribute
Only integral output key types (byte short int long) and explicit standard null policies
If top-level Project masks Sort or ORDER key is an expression, return UNKNOWN; do not parse SQL to guess
Do not confuse inner (CTE/subquery) ordering with final output ordering
Disallow arbitrary wrapper unwrapping and non-global SORT BY
Do not interpret sortedness as correct row membership
negative_controls: No ORDER BY must yield UNKNOWN
ORDER BY hidden/expression key must yield UNKNOWN
novelty: Mechanism is not original; contributes an automated Spark planner-aware obligation extractor as a building block; no publishable claim from this experiment alone
protocol_amendment: Before implementation: removed range_limit accidentally carried from an earlier draft; original frozen manifest has 15 in-scope cases and 2 out-of-scope controls (not 16/2). No execution or scoring had occurred.
